COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPMS No. 1750 of 2024
Hon 'b le Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.
 Mr. Aditya Singh, Ms. Manisha
Bhandari and Mr. Dhruv Chandra, Advocates
for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Anil Dabral, Addl. C.S.C. alongwith
Mr. Suyash Pant, Standing Counsel for the
State.
3. By m eans of this Writ Petition,
petitioner has sought the following reliefs: -
"(i) I ssue a writ order or direction in the
nature of Certiorari quashing the impugned
order dated 25.02.2022 (Annexure-3) passed
by District Magistrate Dehradun and
subsequent proceedings whereby Tehsildar
Dehradun a recovery under UPZALR Act by
issuing auction under Section 73 of the
UPZALR Act"
4. The im pugned order dated 25.02.2022
is on record as Annexure-3 to the Writ
Petition. By the said order, petitioner was
asked to deposit Rs. 38,56,050/ - for
violating the provisions of Uttarakhand
Mineral (Prevention of Illegal Mining,
Storage and Transportation) Rules, 2021.
5. Now, petitioner is facing recovery
proceedings. A sale proclam ation was issued
against him by the Tehsildar, Dehradun. An
auction notice has also been issued in
respect of the land belonging to petitioner
situate in Village Guniyal, Tehsil Dehradun.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioner
subm its that notice regarding sale
proclamation was not served upon the
petitioner and the service has been shown is

of 31.06.2024.
7. Learned State Counsel, however,
subm its that petitioner has a remedy under
Rule 15 of the aforesaid Rules before the
Com m issioner. He further subm its that the
order passed by the District Magistrate is of
25.02.2022, therefore, m uch delay has been
caused in the matter.
8. Be that as it m ay. Since, petitioner has
rem edy of appeal under Rule 15 of the
aforesaid Rules, therefore, the writ petition
is disposed of with liberty to petitioner to
approach the Appellate Authority. If he files
appeal within one week from today, the
sam e shall be decided on m erits, as per law.
9. In view of the undertaking given on
behalf of the petitioner, petitioner is directed
to deposit the entire am ount sought to be
recovered from him before the Appellate
Authority, under protest, which shall abide
by the outcom e of the appeal.
10. For a period of one week, auction sale,
if m ade, shall not be confirm ed.
 ( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.)
 26.06.2024
U.U.
